Given that y1(x)=x2 and y2(x)=x2ln⁡x are solutions to the equation x2y″−3xy′+4y=0, which of the following must also be a solution to the equation?

a
y=x4ln⁡x
b
y=2x6ln⁡x
c
y=5x2ln⁡x
d
y=2x2+ln⁡x
e
y=x4+ln⁡x
